title: Unit Event — Rise and Strive — Episode6 Regrets & the Future

meta.Event Outline: Shizuku's commercial appearance made waves, and job offers for MORE MORE JUMP! are starting to trickle back in. At the same time, it's still unclear what caused the dry spell they experienced. Haruka steels herself and sets up a meeting with someone who may have an idea...

rows.Line: A few days later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I now know why we stopped receiving offers after Idol Lovers...)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
A light that can never go out.
A bright beacon of hope that has a duty to stay illuminated for the sake of their fans.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: At no point can they go out and leave everybody wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What can I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's no way for me to change the past.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I tell the others about this...)
<Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka... Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I know this is sudden.
I just wanted to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, because you haven't been over to SEKAI in quite some time...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You told us that you were going to investigate why you girls stopped receiving offers, remember? I was a little worried that you were burning the candle at both ends.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you for showing so much concern for me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Why the long face? Did something happen...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I found out why we stopped receiving offers... And I was just thinking about how I'm going to tell the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Would you like to tell me what happened?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. An idol can't just leave someone be when their beautiful smile's been turned upside down.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You might feel better after telling someone about what happened. What do you say...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Then, if you don't mind listening for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. And Mr. Hiiragi told you this himself...?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi said that idols are beacons of hope that have a duty to stay illuminated for the sake of their fans, and I haven't been able to get that out of my head.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haruka...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And he's right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I retired from being an idol, I made so many of my fans incredibly sad...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, “sad” probably doesn't even begin to describe how they felt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I robbed everyone of their hope.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, he may be technically correct...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because losing the thing they love most is the worst thing that can happen to a fan.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But the fact of the matter is that you gave quite a lot of people quite a lot of hope when you were still with ASRUN, no?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When I was still with ASRUN...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, and I personally know someone who did. She's been using the hope you gave her as the fuel which propels her forward.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm sure you know who I'm referring to, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm hoping to be an idol one day!
J-J-Just like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka, you gave me my dream of becoming an idol!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, by deciding to leave the stage behind, you caused your fans quite a lot of pain...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But you did your absolute best for them until then, and it's clear now that you gave them hope.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hope that tomorrow will be a better day. That's the truth.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, Haruka, as long as there are people out there who you inspired, then you get to say that you spread hope to them...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also, I don't believe for a second that you're not allowed to be an idol just because you took a slight detour.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I mean...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know that you and only you were able to deliver hope to certain people.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Only I was...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, just think about it.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ultimately, how you deal with this is going to be up to you... But that doesn't mean you have to suffer all alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please ask for help if you ever think you need it. I promise to do everything in my power when you do.

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <I've spent a lot of time thinking after you told me your story, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <It became hard to work on my song because I was so scared that it'd end up hurting more people. However...>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Even after dwelling on this for so long... I realized that I don't want to stop making my own music.>

rows.Speaker: Hasegawa
rows.Line: <Again, Haruka, thank you very much.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What I said to Hasegawa that time, I was able to say because I'd faltered once already.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, you may've faltered, but you're back to spreading hope as an idol again.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, I believe that you will become an idol that can keep spreading hope to others for a very long time.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah... You're right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mr. Hiiragi said how there's no guarantee that an idol can stay lit after having burned out once.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: He's right. I have no way of knowing what's going to happen. All I can really do is vow that it won't happen again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haruka...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I did reach my breaking point...
But in doing so, I also gained a lot and made some profound realizations.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned that some feelings don't change, and I got to form a group with my dear friends.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because of everything that I experienced. All of it. I've been able to see things that I never would have otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After my fall from grace, I was fortunate enough to encounter people and things that have helped make me stronger.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, the current me... Haruka Kiritani of MORE MORE JUMP!... I vow that she'll never fail as an idol again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Obviously, I can't change the fact that I let a lot of my fans down in the past...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that just means I have to do what I can to regain their confidence. So that they feel hope again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So that we can become idols that can spread hope to more people than anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That'd be lovely...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for listening, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still don't have a solid idea of what I need to do yet, but I'll start by asking Minori and the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, that seems like a good plan.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<And we'll be right there rooting for you...
So, do your best.>
